title: Python: E1 (a30): type and metaclass MROs outside the builtin exemption; builtin classes only; fixtures
description: DEC-303 (a30): the builtin-base exemption in instanceClassOf (a29 Q2) covers builtin CLASSES whose construction returns an instance of that class. type, and any class with type in its MRO, is outside it: the site is unresolved and counted receiver-needs-inference. The exemption covers builtin classes only, not every BUILTINS name. Fixtures: type as base, class with type in its MRO through an in-repo base, inherited builtin base (class C(B), class B(Exception)), receiverNeedsInference counts on the Q3 nested-class and inherited-Q2 fixtures; docstring wording. Mutation-check each guard. Runs before N3 and before any sample.
implementationNotes: (a30) built on dev b5a1755. instanceClassOf's opaque exemption is now BUILTIN CLASSES only: a new BUILTIN_INSTANCE_CLASSES set (object, int, float, complex, bool, str, bytes, bytearray, memoryview, list, tuple, dict, set, frozenset, range, slice, property, staticmethod, classmethod, enumerate, zip, map, filter, reversed) plus builtin exception classes by name pattern (names ending Error, Exception or Warning, and StopIteration, StopAsyncIteration, GeneratorExit, KeyboardInterrupt, SystemExit, all required to be in BUILTINS), each unshadowed at the class's own position. type is absent, so a class with type in its MRO (class C(type), or class C(M) with class M(type)) stays opaque: the E1 site is unresolved and counted receiver-needs-inference; builtin functions (print) are not classes. Fixtures: inherited builtin base resolves (class C(B), class B(Exception)); type base, metaclass reached through an in-repo base, builtin function base, and Meta('X', (object,), {}).m() all unresolved with receiverNeedsInference 1 where asserted; a class(object) twin resolves; counts added to the Q3 nested-class fixture (receiverNeedsInference 2, resolvedInRepo 0: the construction and the method call) and the inherited-Q2 fixture (resolvedInRepo 1 for C(), receiverNeedsInference 1 for .m()). MUTATION CHECKS (check mutated, source restored and re-run green after each): type added to the class set: 1 red; any BUILTINS name counts as a class: 1 red; no builtin counts as a class: 2 red; exception pattern off: 2 red. PER-SITE RE-MEASURE: instrumented worktrees at dev b5a1755 vs this branch's calls.ts, five pins with markerDirsFor, bin/reason/edge flags, multiset diff: ZERO changed sites on all five (flask, jinja, httpx, rich, tqdm), bins, polymorphicCount and multiplyBoundCount identical. So the (a30) correction costs no site on the development corpus; it is a soundness fix for a shape the corpus does not contain (a metaclass subclass of type used as an E1 constructor). NOT MEASURED: fresh-sample effect; ExceptionGroup and other builtin classes not in the set stay opaque (conservative); the exact-type exemption of (a29) item 1 is untouched, after step 5.
finalSummary: DEC-303 (a30): the E1 builtin-base exemption covers builtin classes only; type and any class with type in its MRO fail closed; inherited-builtin and count fixtures added; four mutation checks red; zero changed sites on the five development pins.
